jobs.description:
For our client located in DIKSMUIDE, we are looking for a CONSTRUCTION WELDER FIELD.

Our client is a well-known company active in water pumps and water treatment. They are a close-knit team where employees are always the number one priority.

As a CONSTRUCTION WELDER FIELD in the DIKSMUIDE region, you will perform the following tasks:

  • Assembling and welding steel structures such as screws, water treatment installations, and other constructions;
  • Building structures according to assembly plans and guidelines;
  • Using various welding techniques: TIG, MIG, and electrode welding;
  • Checking dimensions, shapes, weld seams, and overall quality;
  • Adjusting parts where necessary in case of deformations or defects;
  • Working with different welding machines and, when required, operating equipment such as overhead cranes and aerial work platforms.
As a CONSTRUCTION WELDER FIELD in the DIKSMUIDE region, you can identify yourself with the following:

  • You have experience or a diploma as a welder, with knowledge of various welding techniques;
  • You possess all required certificates (mandatory);
  • You have a good understanding of reading technical drawings and using various assembly techniques and equipment;
  • You are able to work independently, are allowed to do so, and take initiative;
  • You have basic knowledge of electrical systems and hydraulics;
  • You have a driving licence B;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client in the ICHTEGEM region, we are looking for a CE TIPPER TRUCK DRIVER.

Our client is a family-owned company specialized in bulk transport, concrete transport, tipper truck transport and traction transport.

As a CE TIPPER TRUCK DRIVER in ICHTEGEM, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

  • Delivering soil and waste materials from earthworks using a tipper truck;
  • Transporting and delivering materials in accordance with safety regulations and applicable instructions;
  • Cleaning the truck;
  • Communicating with customers in a friendly and professional manner;
  • Unloading the truck at construction sites and driving back to reload.
As a CE DRIVER in NIEUWPOORT, you can identify with the following:

  • Experience as a CE DRIVER;
  • You are in possession of a CE driving licence, a valid Code 95 and a driver card;
  • You speak Dutch OR English OR French.

Are you an experienced roller operator with a passion for asphalt works?

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced roller operator for our asphalt works.

What does your job involve?

  • You independently operate the road roller during asphalt works.
  • You ensure the correct and even compaction of the asphalt according to the required quality standards.
  • You take into account the temperature and composition of the asphalt and adapt your working method accordingly.
  • You work closely with machine operators, drivers and other colleagues in the asphalt crew.
  • You help monitor the quality of the road surface and ensure that the works are carried out accurately.
  • You work with modern machines, techniques and tools.
  • You carry out daily checks and help ensure the proper maintenance of the machine.
  • You depart daily from the depot in Oostende.
What do we expect from you?

  • You have experience as a road roller operator, preferably in asphalt or road construction.
  • You have a good understanding of asphalt compaction and understand the importance of using the correct rolling technique.
  • You have good technical insight and can work confidently with modern machinery.
  • You are flexible and have no problem working in different weather conditions.
  • You speak fluent Dutch or English.
  • You are able to get to our depot in Oostende independently every day.

Are you an experienced asphalt worker who enjoys rolling up your sleeves?

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced asphalt worker to join our asphalt crew.

What does your job involve?

  • You assist the asphalt crew with the preparation, laying and finishing of hot-mix asphalt;
  • You help ensure the correct distribution and finishing of the asphalt;
  • You are responsible for touching up and finishing asphalt around joints and connections;
  • You help create a smooth and high-quality road surface;
  • You work closely with machine operators, roller operators, drivers and other colleagues on site;
  • You work with modern machinery, techniques and tools;
  • You depart daily from Oostende.
What do we expect from you?

  • You have experience in asphalt works, preferably as an asphalt worker;
  • You have knowledge of the different steps involved in laying and finishing hot-mix asphalt;
  • You are physically fit and enjoy active, hands-on work;
  • You are flexible and have no problem working in different weather conditions;
  • You speak fluent Dutch or English;
  • You are able to get to our depot in Oostende independently every day.

For the strengthening of our team, we are looking for a truck driver with a Category C driving licence to operate our emulsion truck.

You will depart from our depot in Oostende and drive to various construction sites throughout West Flanders. In addition to the transport, you will also be responsible for the correct application and processing of the emulsion on site, meaning you will be active both behind the wheel and on the construction site.

Your responsibilities:

  • You transport emulsion from our depot in Oostende to various construction sites throughout West Flanders;
  • You are responsible for the correct and safe loading and unloading of emulsion;
  • You operate the emulsion truck's equipment and ensure the correct application of the emulsion;
  • You work both with machinery and manually during the processing of emulsion on site.



What do we expect from you?

  • You have a valid Category C driving licence.
  • Code 95 is NOT required.
  • You have good technical insight and are willing to learn how the emulsion truck operates and how emulsion is processed on site.
  • You speak and understand sufficient Dutch or English to communicate safely and smoothly with your colleagues.

Would you like to help build high-quality roads throughout West Flanders? Then we would love to hear from you!

jobs.occupation: ECommerce specialist - Waals Brabant - Dutch speaker
jobs.description:
Join a fast-growing international retail group operating across several European markets. With a strong omnichannel model combining an extensive physical store network with high-performing e-commerce platforms, the company is experiencing continued growth and digital transformation. Customer experience, innovation and operational excellence are at the heart of its strategy.

Jobomschrijving

This is a hands-on operational role for someone who likes to be at the heart of the action: monitoring online performance, solving issues, coordinating with different teams and making sure customers enjoy a smooth journey from click to delivery.

You will act as a key point of contact between E-commerce, IT, Customer Service, Logistics and external partners, ensuring that the online business runs efficiently every day.

Your Responsibilities

• Monitor the daily performance of the e-commerce platforms and key operational KPIs, identifying opportunities and potential issues.
• Ensure a smooth and reliable online customer journey, from website navigation and checkout to payment and delivery.
• Investigate and resolve operational issues, proactively identifying root causes and coordinating corrective actions.
• Act as the operational bridge between E-commerce, IT, Customer Service, Logistics, Project teams and external partners.
• Follow up on payment, delivery and order-related processes, ensuring issues are addressed quickly and efficiently.
• Coordinate the management of incidents and technical issues, prioritising them according to their impact on customers and the business.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of e-commerce processes, tools and ways of working.
• Analyse performance and operational data to identify trends, recurring issues and areas for improvement.
• Support the implementation of new e-commerce initiatives, projects and system enhancements.
• Ensure a high level of data accuracy, operational quality and customer satisfaction across the online channel.

• You have 2-5 years of experience in e-commerce operations, digital operations, online retail or a similar hands-on environment.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English; Dutch is mandatory for the role. French is a strong plus.
• You have a strong operational mindset and enjoy getting into the details to understand and solve problems.
• You are analytical, structured and solution-oriented, with a natural ability to prioritise.
• You are comfortable working cross-functionally and coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
• You don't wait for problems to solve themselves: you are proactive, hands-on and pragmatic.
• You have a genuine interest in retail, e-commerce and customer experience.
• Experience with e-commerce platforms, order management systems, payment solutions, ticketing tools or analytics platforms is a plus.

employee experience for people everywhere.
 

Our powerful platform acts as a personal digital assistant to streamline communication and
 

create a more unified team and bring everything employees need into one simple, unified app.
 

We help leading companies improve their workplace culture and boost productivity by putting
 

employees first.

sector? Do you love organizing, problem-solving, and helping teams thrive?

Customer Support to join us in our vibrant office in Antwerp Zuid. Working alongside our CS

the ropes of Customer Success from the ground up, take ownership of vital administrative
 

workflows, and grow within a supportive, dynamic team.

and a crucial champion for our customers. This role is designed to give you a 360-degree view
 

of how a SaaS company operates. You will build a rock-solid foundation in Customer Success
 

and Support by managing vital customer touchpoints, coordinating internal workflows, and
 

working towards direct ownership of your own client portfolio.

customer questions into fast solutions and keeping our users happy and engaged.
 
 

• Empowering the CS Team: Partner closely with the Head of CS and CS  

Manager on key client initiatives—from drafting high-impact client communications and
 

creating essential product documentation to onboarding new clients.
 
 

• Internal Project Coordination: Act as the ultimate team facilitator by managing  

internal workflows, tracking cross-functional to-do's, and collaborating with colleagues
 

across Spencer to ensure we deliver on our promises.
 

 
 

What You Bring to the Table
 

We're looking for someone with the right mindset and a foundation of great skills.

• A proactive, self-driven, and entrepreneurial mindset with a high level of initiative.

• The ability to understand customer needs, pain points, and business objectives. 

• A collaborative and team-oriented spirit. 

• Fluent in Dutch, with professional working proficiency in English and French. 

• Fast learner when it comes to digital tools, software, and platforms.  

What We Offer
 
 

• A competitive salary and a clear growth path with direct mentorship. 

• The opportunity to join a supportive and growing team and take real ownership of your work. 

• A great benefits package  

How to Apply
 

Ready to join us? Apply directly on LinkedIn or send your resume to jobs@spencer.co. We can't
 

wait to hear from you!

jobs.description:

Business Analyst (Junior or Senior) — Ghent
 

Are you ready to learn fast and make a real impact, working side by side with a small, close-knit team in Ghent? At Corlutions, we've been helping companies grow with Odoo since 2019, and we're expanding our team to do even more of that.
 

 
 

About Corlutions
 

Corlutions is a digitalization partner for small and medium-sized enterprises, specializing in Odoo-based solutions that help organizations reduce costs and increase revenue. We work closely with clients across sectors like manufacturing, construction, wholesale, and finance — always living by our principle: "Together is better."
 

 
 

What is a Business Analyst at Corlutions?
 

As a Business Analyst, your mission is to help our clients optimize their business processes through smart, well-implemented software — primarily Odoo and Business Intelligence. You'll gather and document business requirements, and translate them into clear functional specifications that guide every project.
 

You'll work closely with clients to ensure optimal use of Odoo apps such as Accounting, Point of Sales, eCommerce, Manufacturing, Inventory, Projects, Websites, Sales and more. By diving into your client's needs and processes, and providing personalized training, you'll become the go-to expert for their management solutions.
 

In your first weeks, you'll get comprehensive training before jumping into your first projects — always with the support of your mentor and colleagues. As you gain experience, you'll gain autonomy too. Collaboration stays key throughout: you'll be in regular contact with clients, developers, and the internal team.
 

 
 

Responsibilities
 

Project Implementation (80%)
 
 

• Gain the trust of your customers 

• Analyse needs, gather and document requirements, and suggest and implement solutions (configuration, development and testing) 

• Provide training 

• Follow-up and communication about ongoing tasks  

Internal improvement (20%)
 
 

• Feedback to the internal team 

• Mentoring and training 

• Feedback for improvement  

Optional: support other domains such as marketing, HR and accounting at Corlutions (impacts the % split above).
 

 
 

What's great about the job?
 

Expect real responsibility from day one, in a friendly and open environment where you'll work both independently and collaboratively. You'll take on a variety of projects across different industries, broadening your experience along the way. As a bonus, you'll go through an in-depth training provided by Odoo.
 

 
 

What we offer
 
 

• Sponsored events — afterworks and team buildings 

• Trainings — a real learning and development program 

• Green coworking space — we work from Pentagon, a green coworking space surrounded by water in Ghent 

• Sport activity — play any sport with colleagues, the bill might be covered! 

• Eat & drink — fruit basket and coffee on the house  

 
 

Ready to start your adventure? Apply now

Must Have
 
 

• Bachelor or Master's degree 

• Fluent in English and Dutch 

• Strong analytical mindset, with an interest in business analysis 

• Good communication and negotiation skills 

• Autonomous, assertive & proactive 

• Affinity with the IT world, and interest in Odoo, ERP and Business Intelligence tools 

• Learn fast and have a "Can Do" attitude  

Nice to Have
 
 

• Background in Business Administration, Applied Economics, Civil Engineering, Computer Sciences, or Business Intelligence experience 

• Fluent in French 

• Experience across different domains (marketing, HR, accounting) is a plus 

• Technical knowledge (XML, Python, JS, SQL, programming)

jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
Join our Technical Department team as a Production Support Technician! In this role, you will be responsible for developing work instructions and methods, as well as providing the necessary production tools to ensure smooth workflow in the workshops and high-quality outcomes for our customers.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your role:

• You analyze the technical information obtained from the manufacturer via the Engineering department and integrate it into the ERP system.
• You are responsible for writing, updating and translating the technical working documents, taking into account the strict application of the aviation regulations and the instructions of the manufacturer. You ensure the implementation of the technical working documents in the workshops and ensure their correct application.
• You participate in the continuous improvement processes within the department.
• You participate and/or coordinate the improvements of the current working methods and introduce possible new technologies. You ensure the sharing of information as a result of 'retour d'expérience' (RETEX) by means of an infoshop for the mechanics in case of new or improved work instructions.
• You provide technical support to the workshops, both theoretical and practical (if necessary), and look for solutions in case of problems in order to avoid a delay of the production process. You ensure the delivery of the necessary tooling to the workshops and guarantee its correct use by drawing up adequate work instructions.
• You participate in the industrialisation (MRO and NEW) of new types of engines.
• You make repair proposals to the manufacturer in order to make the parts repairable.
• You draw up specifications for the means of production.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree in electromechanics or aeronautics, preferably with a first experience in repair methods.
• You speak French or Dutch, with a good knowledge of the other national language and you are willing to improve your skills. You also have a good knowledge of technical English.
• You have good knowledge of electromechanics, mechanics and repair technologies.
• You have knowledge of engines and engine parts.
• You are an analytical and synthetic person and can anticipate.
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment and you are willing to support your colleagues.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.
